warnings: Every footing is printed 'F<n>,C2' — footing mark + the column stub C2 standing on it (C2 = 0.20x0.20, 6-DB12 on S-06). C2 is recorded here once (23 points); the floor columns C1 are on S-02 (16 of these points — the 7 porch/terrace points B1, E1, F3, F5', F7, G3', G5 carry no C1 there).
F2 (two-pile cap, 0.90 x 0.36 on S-05) is drawn with the 0.90 side along x at all four points: C3, C4, C6, E3. Every other point is F1 (single pile).
Off-main-grid points: E3'' (x 6.50, chain 3 +1.50), E5'/F5' (x 9.50, chain 5 +0.50) and G3' (x 7.00, the printed 3' bubble); see the grid master.
